*CS408– GDB SOLUTION BY mano*

*Answer:* Constraints

*Constraints is the most suitable HCI technique because* it prevents mistakes before they happen. Disabling the Final Submit button until a file is uploaded successfully, and requiring students to review the selected file before confirming, stops repeated clicks and wrong-file submissions. This reduces errors and lets students submit confidently under time pressure, *whereas Feedback and Visibility* only inform or guide students and cannot block mistakes.
